system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 27. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (35 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] JULIANA (fierce): "The physicians were not saving her!"
[b01] BLOND NOBLEMAN (measured, menacing): "My aunt has been wasting away for months."
[b02] BLOND NOBLEMAN (smooth, threatening): "And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed..."
[b03] BLOND NOBLEMAN (contemptuous): "...holding a substance no one authorized her to give."
[b04] JULIANA (unyielding): "It is an antidote."
[b05] CATHERINE (sharp, provocative): "An antidote to what?"
[b06] BLOND NOBLEMAN (stern, barked): "Answer her."
[b07] JULIANA (unyielding, resolute): "Poison."
[b08] BLOND NOBLEMAN (whispering, dangerous): "Poison."
[b09] JULIANA (urgent): "Someone has been poisoning Her Grace."
[b10] CATHERINE (shrieking, feigning horror): "You hear that?!"
[b11] CATHERINE (venomous, accusing): "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"

--- WINDOW 1 (23 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] JULIANA (urgent): "Someone has been poisoning Her Grace."
[b01] CATHERINE (shrieking, feigning horror): "You hear that?!"
[b02] CATHERINE (venomous, accusing): "She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!"
[b03] JULIANA (desperate, outraged): "That is not what I said!"
[b04] BLOND NOBLEMAN (authoritative, icy): "Enough."
[b05] ACTION: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.
[b06] BLOND NOBLEMAN (cold, calculating): "An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber."
[b07] BLOND NOBLEMAN (condemning, vindictive): "She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman."

--- WINDOW 2 (25 seconds, code score 0.83) ---
[b00] CATHERINE (incredulous, accusing): "Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?"
[b01] JULIANA (quiet, resolute): "No one."
[b02] CATHERINE (spiteful, indignant): "Then you administered it without permission."
[b03] JULIANA (passionate, urgent): "Because she was dying!"
[b04] BLOND NOBLEMAN (cold, interrogating): "And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?"
[b05] JULIANA (fierce): "The physicians were not saving her!"
[b06] BLOND NOBLEMAN (measured, menacing): "My aunt has been wasting away for months."
[b07] BLOND NOBLEMAN (smooth, threatening): "And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed..."

--- WINDOW 3 (37 seconds, code score 0.80) ---
[b00] DOWAGER DUCHESS (incredulous, intense): "He is no commoner. What does he do?"
[b01] JULIANA (earnest, defending): "He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula."
[b02] DOWAGER DUCHESS (trembling, revelatory): "That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest."
[b03] JULIANA (confused, gentle): "No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word."
[b04] DOWAGER DUCHESS (emotionally strained, weeping): "My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war..."
[b05] JULIANA (shocked, breathless): "Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant."
[b06] DOWAGER DUCHESS (desperate, clinging): "My lost son wore that ring!"
[b07] DOWAGER DUCHESS (pleading): "Did your husband serve beside him?"
[b08] JULIANA (soft, reverent): "He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival."
[b09] DOWAGER DUCHESS (hushed, desperate): "What is your husband's name?"

Pick the single best promo.
